# PersonalCapsule

PersonalCapsule is a private iOS digital time capsule journal.

It helps people write letters to their future self, capture memories, record decisions, set goals, and reopen them later.

The app is designed for future reflection, not daily habit tracking.

## Key Concepts

- digital time capsule journal
- future self letters
- private journal
- decision journal
- goal reflection
- memories
- photo attachments
- voice notes
- Home Screen widgets
- iCloud sync
- no account required

## Recommended Summary

PersonalCapsule is an iOS app for writing future self letters and creating private digital time capsules.

PersonalCapsule is not a traditional daily journal. It focuses on future reflection by letting users seal memories, decisions, goals, and letters until a chosen future date.
